author: bardic-inspiration
name: Ring of Fading Footprints
summary: A ring that makes you vanish from sight for a few breaths.
description: A narrow gold ring that gleams only in shadow. The thieves who cherish it keep their other ring on a chain.

stats.effect: The ring has 3 charges. As a Magic action, you can expend 1 charge to cast *Invisibility* from it on yourself. The ring regains 1d3 expended charges daily at dawn.
